consumer.description: Custom type for representing a foreign key with a null value allowed.

consumer_group.description: Custom type for representing a foreign key with a null value allowed.

protocols.description: A set of strings representing HTTP protocols.

config.description: The configuration for MCP authorization in OAuth2. If this is enabled, make sure the configured metadata_endpoint is also covered by the same route so the authorization can be applied correctly.

max_request_body_size.description: max allowed body size allowed to be introspected. 0 means unlimited, but the size of this body will still be limited by Nginx's client_max_body_size.

metadata_endpoint.description: The path for OAuth 2.0 Protected Resource Metadata. Default to $resource/.well-known/oauth-protected-resource. For example, if the configured resource is https://api.example.com/mcp, the metadata endpoint is /mcp/.well-known/oauth-protected-resource.

expected_audience.description: The expected `aud` claim value for access token audience validation. When unset, the plugin expects `config.resource`. When `config.insecure_relaxed_audience_validation` is `true`, audience validation is disabled and this field is ignored.

elements.description: Recommended scopes that are used in authorization requests to request access to this protected resource.

claim_to_header.description: Map top-level token claims to upstream headers. Mutually exclusive with upstream_headers.

claim.description: The claim name to be used in the access token.

header.description: The HTTP header name to be used for forwarding the claim value to the upstream.

upstream_headers.description: Map token claims to upstream headers using path-based access. Each entry specifies a header name and a path (array of strings) to traverse the token claims. Mutually exclusive with claim_to_header.

path.description: The path of the header value.

passthrough_credentials.description: Keep the credentials used for authentication in the request. If multiple credentials are sent with the same request, the plugin will keep those that were used for successful authentication.

consumer_claim.description: The claim used for consumer mapping. If multiple values are set, it means the claim is inside a nested object of the token payload.

consumer_by.description: Consumer fields used for mapping: - `id`: try to find the matching Consumer by `id` - `username`: try to find the matching Consumer by `username` - `custom_id`: try to find the matching Consumer by `custom_id`.

consumer_optional.description: Do not terminate the request if consumer mapping fails.

consumer_groups_claim.description: The claim used for consumer groups mapping. If multiple values are set, it means the claim is inside a nested object of the token payload.

consumer_groups_optional.description: Do not terminate the request if consumer groups mapping fails.

credential_claim.description: The claim used to derive virtual credentials (e.g. to be consumed by the rate-limiting plugin), in case the consumer mapping is not used. If multiple values are set, it means the claim is inside a nested object of the token payload.

cache_introspection.description: If enabled, the plugin will cache the introspection response for the access token. This can improve performance by reducing the number of introspection requests to the authorization server.

insecure_relaxed_audience_validation.description: If enabled, the plugin will not validate the audience of the access token. Disable it if the authorization server does not correctly set the audience claim according to RFC 8707 and MCP specification.

jwks_endpoint.description: The JWKS endpoint URL for fetching the authorization server's public keys. If not provided, the plugin will attempt to discover it from the authorization server metadata.

metadata_discovery_endpoint.description: Custom OAuth 2.0 authorization server metadata discovery URL. If provided, the plugin will use this URL directly instead of trying standard well-known discovery paths. The custom endpoint URL should end with either '/.well-known/openid-configuration' or '/.well-known/oauth-authorization-server'.

jwks_cache_ttl.description: The cache TTL in seconds for JWKS.

metadata_cache_ttl.description: The cache TTL in seconds for discovered authorization server metadata.

metadata_discovery_retry.description: The number of retry attempts for metadata discovery requests per URL.

jwt_claims_leeway.description: The leeway in seconds for JWT claims validation (exp, nbf). This allows tokens that are slightly expired or not yet valid due to clock skew.

http_proxy_host.description: A string representing a host name, such as example.com.

http_proxy_port.description: An integer representing a port number between 0 and 65535, inclusive.

https_proxy_host.description: A string representing a host name, such as example.com.

https_proxy_port.description: An integer representing a port number between 0 and 65535, inclusive.

proxy_scheme.description: The proxy scheme to use when connecting. Only `http` is supported.

auth_username.description: The username to authenticate with, if the forward proxy is protected by basic authentication.

auth_password.description: The password to authenticate with, if the forward proxy is protected by basic authentication.

no_proxy.description: Comma-separated list of hosts that should not be proxied.

token_exchange.description: Configuration details about token exchange that should happen before reaching upstream MCP server

enabled.description: Whether Token Exchange should be enabled

client_auth.description: The type of authentication method to use with the exchange endpoint. Use 'inherit' to use the same client_id, and secret as in introspection_endpoint.

resource.description: The absolute URI of target MCP service where token will be used.

audience.description: Audiences used in the token exchange request.

scopes.description: Scopes used in the token exchange request.

subject_token_type.description: The type of token to be exchanged.

actor_token_header.description: Header name containing actor token (when source is header).

actor_token.description: Static actor token value (when source is config).

actor_token_type.description: The token type identifier of actor token.

ttl.description: The default cache TTL to store exchanged token. If the exchange endpoint does not provide 'expires_in' data when token is exchanged this TTL value will be used to cache it.

introspection_endpoint.description: The Token Introspection Endpoint. If not provided, the plugin will attempt to use JWKS to verify the token. If the token is opaque, this field must be provided.

mtls_introspection_endpoint.description: The mTLS alias for the introspection endpoint.

client_jwk.description: The client JWK for private_key_jwt authentication.

args.description: Additional arguments to send in the POST body.

headers.description: Additional headers for the introspection request.

http_version.description: The HTTP version used for requests.
